press.line: A NASA photograph taken at Kennedy Space Center, Florida, on July 16, 1969. News reporters from around the world watch the Apollo 11 rocket lift off, more than three miles away across the water. NASA. Free to use.

campers.line: NASA photo, July 16, 1969: some of the thousands of families who camped on beaches and roads near the Kennedy Space Center to watch Apollo 11 launch (KSC-69P-0623, public domain).
